h1: Custom Foam Badges for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom foam badges in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Ideal for events, safety, and branding. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Foam badges offer a lightweight, durable alternative to traditional metal or plastic badges. They are comfortable to wear all day, making them ideal for trade shows, volunteer events, and safety teams. The soft material accepts vibrant screen printing or embroidery, ensuring your logo stands out. Choose foam badges when you need a cost-effective, no-scratch option for large groups.
heroAltText: Custom foam badges in various colors and shapes, perfect for branding and events
